title: File Format & Parser Exploits
description: Risks in document, media, image, font, and archive processing.

attacks.name: ImageMagick (ImageTragick)
attacks.desc: Affected ImageMagick delegates may interpret crafted image files as commands or unsafe resource references.
attacks.prevention: Patch ImageMagick and its delegates, restrict risky coders, and process untrusted images in a sandbox.

attacks.name: Ghostscript RCE
attacks.desc: Affected Ghostscript versions may execute unsafe PostScript embedded in a document processed by the server.
attacks.prevention: Keep Ghostscript patched, avoid processing unnecessary formats, and isolate document conversion from the host.

attacks.name: PDF.js exploitation
attacks.desc: A malicious PDF can target bugs in a browser-based PDF viewer such as PDF.js.
attacks.prevention: Update PDF.js promptly and apply browser isolation to documents from untrusted users.

attacks.name: SVG parser abuse
attacks.desc: SVG files can contain active content or external references that require careful handling and sanitization.
attacks.prevention: Sanitize SVG or serve it as a download from a separate origin; block external references during processing.

attacks.name: DOCX/XLSX XXE
attacks.desc: Unsafe XML parsing inside office documents can resolve external entities or access server-side resources.
attacks.prevention: Disable external entities and network access in XML parsers used for office document extraction.

attacks.name: XLSX formula injection
attacks.desc: Spreadsheet formulas can execute actions or fetch data when a user opens an untrusted XLSX file.

attacks.name: CSV injection
attacks.desc: CSV cells beginning with formula characters can be interpreted as commands or links by spreadsheet software.

attacks.name: Polyglot file
attacks.desc: A file valid in multiple formats can pass one validator yet be interpreted differently by another component.

attacks.name: Font parser abuse
attacks.desc: Malformed font data can target vulnerabilities in software that decodes TTF or WOFF files.

attacks.name: Video container abuse
attacks.desc: Malformed media container metadata can trigger parser faults in video processing components.

attacks.name: EXIF abuse
attacks.notes: Metadata XSS, path traversal in filename
attacks.desc: Untrusted EXIF fields or filenames can become an injection source when displayed or used as paths.

attacks.name: Archive symlink
attacks.desc: Archive entries that are symbolic links can redirect extraction outside the intended destination.

attacks.name: Nested zip bomb
attacks.desc: Deeply nested archives can exhaust storage or compute during recursive extraction.

attacks.name: Zip path traversal
attacks.desc: Archive member names containing parent paths can write files outside the extraction directory.
